title: BEGIN YOUR
SUNRISE PRAYER
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: dark misty mountain valley before dawn blue hour
golden sunlight slowly creeping over dark forest trees
warm morning sun rays shining through peaceful bedroom window
mist rising gently over a calm serene glassy mountain lake
bright golden morning light illuminating quiet valley landscape
radiant sunrise sky with soft clouds and gentle warm glow
peaceful morning horizon with bright light of new day
serene mountain peak bathed in warm golden morning sun

scenes.a: Welcome the quiet of this new morning as the darkness slowly fades away.
Step into the fresh light that God has prepared for your soul today.
Listen closely to the ancient truth found within the sacred scriptures.
For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime.
Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
Let this promise anchor your heart against every fear and every doubt.
Father, fill us with your steadfast peace as we walk through this day.
Subscribe to The Morning Altar for daily prayer and sunrise scripture.
